eyebrow.zh: 调用点拦截 · 拒绝默认 · 本地零依赖

headline.zh:
装进 Agent 的每个 Skill
都被拦在越界的那一步
headline.en:
Every Skill you install
stops at the call it shouldn't make

sub.zh: Capsule 在工具调用的那一刻就拦下越界的工具、路径与网络请求——不是装载前的君子协定，也不是事后的审计日志。
sub.en: Capsule traps out-of-bound tool, path, and network calls the moment they happen — not a load-time promise, not an after-the-fact audit.

title.zh: 在调用点当场拦下，不是事后记账
title.en: Blocked at the call site, not after the fact

body.zh: 技能试图 curl 外发、读取 ~/.ssh，Capsule 在那一刻拒绝并打印 DENIED——越界的调用根本不会执行。
body.en: A skill tries to curl out or read ~/.ssh; Capsule refuses it on the spot with a DENIED line — the call never runs.

title.zh: 一份声明式 profile 决定能碰什么
title.en: One declarative profile decides what it may touch

body.zh: 用一份 YAML 声明工具、路径读写与网络出口；不在声明里的，一律拒绝。
body.en: Declare tools, path read/write, and network egress in one YAML — anything not declared is denied.

title.zh: 一条命令复现真实拦截
title.en: Reproduce a real block in one command

body.zh: 自带的恶意 demo Skill 会尝试外发与读密钥；用 deny-by-default profile 跑一遍，五分钟内看到第一次拦截。
body.en: A deliberately malicious demo skill tries to exfiltrate and read keys; run it under a deny-by-default profile and see your first block in under five minutes.

title.en: A report right after the block

body.zh: 每次运行的允许/拦截计数与触发规则，一条 capsule report 拉成表格。
body.en: Allowed-vs-blocked counts and the rule that fired, as one capsule report table.

headline.zh: 把不信任的 Skill 关进沙箱，再放出来跑
headline.en: Sandbox the skills you don't trust, then let them run

tag.zh: 本地引擎 · 开源 · Apache-2.0
